plain: An official estimate of what property is worth

webster.text: The act of estimating the value or worth; the act of setting a price; as the just valuation of civil and religious privileges.

more.text: Value set upon a thing; estimated worth.

example.quote: In every country it is a herculean task to obtain a valuation of the land; in a country imperfectly settled and progressive in improvement, the difficulties are increased almost to impracticability.
